title.value: Electrical conduit rerouting due to unforeseen structural grade beam
title.evidence: Title: Electrical conduit rerouting due to unforeseen structural grade beam

description.value: Reroute electrical power feeds and branch circuits around newly exposed subsurface grade beam discovered during basement slab excavation, per RFI-084 response and Engineer Sketch SK-012. Includes core drilling, additional 3-inch rigid conduit, junction boxes, and pulling conductors.
